# Feature matrix: ClickHouse Cloud vs Altinity Stable vs upstream OSS

> **Status: generated by `bench feature-matrix`.** A cell with a **Probed:** note carries the
> outcome of its probe(s) on the exact server version (the newest run of that platform); a cell
> without one is a cited hypothesis *(h)*. Local tiers establish capability and defaults only,
> never performance.
>
> **cloud:** not probed yet; its cells are cited hypotheses *(h)*.
>
> **altinity** (`26.3.33.10001.altinitystable`), confirmed/probed per target: `kind` 50/50 (run `20261008T074804Z-584a`), `local-cluster` 50/50 (run `20261008T074801Z-3bda`), `local-cluster-2x2` 50/50 (run `20261008T074802Z-6f04`), `local-cluster-s3-cow` 50/50 (run `20261008T084352Z-d8d5`), `local-cluster-s3-smallcache` 50/50 (run `20261008T081145Z-212e`), `local-single` 44/44 (run `20261008T074800Z-bf28`).
>
> **upstream-oss** (`26.3.33.24`), confirmed/probed per target: `kind` 50/50 (run `20261008T081834Z-2ea0`), `local-cluster` 50/50 (run `20261008T074807Z-c68d`), `local-single` 44/44 (run `20261008T074806Z-e648`).

Targets and versions (pinned in [`research/versions.md`](research/versions.md)):

| Target | Planned version |
| --- | --- |
| **cloud** | ClickHouse Cloud. 26.6 on the Fast/Regular channels and 26.4 on Slow as of 2026-10-08. SharedMergeTree on object storage. |
| **altinity** | `26.3.33.10001.altinitystable`, Altinity operator 0.27.4 plus ClickHouse Keeper |
| **upstream-oss** | `26.3.33.24`, same base version and same topology as altinity |

## 1. Storage and replication

| ID | Capability | cloud | altinity / upstream-oss | Source | Planned probe |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **ST-01** | **Engine actually used for `ENGINE = MergeTree` / `ReplicatedMergeTree`** | SharedMergeTree; Cloud "automatically substitutes the corresponding `Shared*` engine" *(h)* | As written. Plain `MergeTree` on a 2-replica cluster creates independent, unreplicated tables per replica. This is OpenMeter's hard-coded engine.<br>**Probed:** altinity ✔ confirmed on `26.3.33.10001.altinitystable` (storage/engine_conversion); altinity ✔ confirmed on `26.3.33.10001.altinitystable` (storage/replicated_engine_conversion); upstream-oss ✔ confirmed on `26.3.33.24` (storage/engine_conversion); upstream-oss ✔ confirmed on `26.3.33.24` (storage/replicated_engine_conversion) | [cloud-compatibility](https://clickhouse.com/docs/products/cloud/guides/cloud-compatibility) | `probes/storage/engine_conversion.sql` + `probes/storage/replicated_engine_conversion.sql` |

| ID | Capability | cloud | self-managed | Source | Probe / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CO-01 | Compute-compute separation (warehouses) | ✅ Scale tier and above. Read-only services "don't execute background merges". *(h)* | ❌ No equivalent. The closest options are dedicated read replicas, or Antalya swarms for object-storage data. *(h)* | [warehouses](https://clickhouse.com/docs/products/cloud/features/infrastructure/warehouses) | assessed, not measured (optional Cloud experiment) |

## Starting hypotheses checked against sources so far

- **Refuted:** executable UDFs as "self-managed only" (SM-03). Cloud documents them as GA.
- **Refined:** Cloud uses the **Shared** database engine, not `Replicated` (ST-02).
- **New:** `async_insert=1` and deduplicate-all-inserts became defaults in 26.2 (IN-01, IN-03). Every target in this evaluation is ≥ 26.2, so OpenMeter's inserts are async on all of them unless the sink sets `async_insert=0`.
- **New:** lightweight `UPDATE` is still beta in 26.x (VG-05). Lightweight mutations fail on tables with projections (VG-10).
- **New (§9):** distributed reads fall back to stale replicas by default
  (RS-02), and upstream `load_balancing=random` lets successive reads differ
  (RS-03). `select_sequential_consistency` alone is insufficient on
  ReplicatedMergeTree (RS-04).
- **New (§10):** sources conflict on whether Cloud replicas use a local SSD
  filesystem cache (CS-02), so it must be probed. Cloud fills the cache on
  writes by default; self-managed does not (CS-03).
- **New (§11):** Cloud vertical autoscaling uses 3 h and 30 h windows, so it
  does not follow short peaks; scheduled scaling or idling does (SC-01/03/04).
  The EBS "6-hour modification cooldown" is out of date: the limit is now 4
  modifications per rolling 24 h (SC-05).
